name: stm32l476
description: ST STM32L476xG (Cortex-M4F 80 MHz, 1 MB dual-bank flash, 96 KB SRAM1 + 32 KB SRAM2, segment LCD, 3 ADCs, 2 DACs, COMP, OPAMP, SWPMI, RNG): GNU Arm toolchain with the STM32CubeL4 HAL/LL, Renode stm32l476 platform (board NUCLEO-L476RG)

toolchain.notes: Link with a STM32L476RGTx_FLASH.ld and startup_stm32l476xx.s from a Cube example (Projects/NUCLEO-L476RG/Templates/SW4STM32). Whole Cube examples build with tools/stm32cube/build_example.py in the Renode tree (sources, includes and defines from the example's SW4STM32 project).

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0x08000000

renode.notes: Board: platforms/boards/st/nucleo_l476rg.repl (LD2 PA5 = led2, B1 PC13 = sysbus.gpioPortC.userButton, active low, VCP usart2). SRAM2 is also aliased at 0x20018000. The CPU runs at PerformanceInMips 80; LL code that busy-polls SysTick (LL_mDelay) is MMIO-bound, so 'cpu PerformanceInMips 10' makes such firmware about ten times faster to emulate. DMA requests go through dmaRouter (STM32L4_DMARequestRouter, CSELR of DMA1/DMA2); timer channels drive their alternate-function pins; EXTICR lives in extiMux. ADC: 'adc1 SetVoltage 1650000 0' (microvolts, channel). UART input: 'usart2 WriteChar 0x31'. Test fixtures: tools/stm32cube/fixtures (lsi_tim16_l4.repl feeds the 32 kHz LSI to TIM16 for the IWDG examples' LSI measurement). Not modelled: ADC2/ADC3 (dual mode), COMP/OPAMP analog behaviour, the firewall, SWPMI, USB OTG FS, RTC tamper and backup registers above BKP19, controller-to-controller I2C/SPI wiring. Docs: tools/stm32cube/README.md (examples_l476.txt).

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the STM32CubeL4 examples (tools/stm32cube/run_examples.py with examples_l476.txt in the Renode tree)
